decisions.decision: Facilities directed to prepare cost estimates for roof replacement, demolition, and partial preservation scenarios for FY28 capital planning cycle
decisions.quote: facilities (chris ruth) to prepare cost estimates and options for fy28 / next capital planning cycle:

decisions.decision: Committee to develop consolidated list of municipal space needs including offices, records storage, vault, voting storage, conference rooms, and common areas with square footage requirements
decisions.quote: committee to develop a consolidated list of municipal space needs (offices, records storage, vault, voting storage/operations, conference/meeting rooms, common areas) and to quantify required square footage

decisions.decision: Committee to engage stakeholders including Food Pantry, Teen Center, Eagle House, and Council on Aging to document program needs and transition options
decisions.quote: engage community stakeholders (food pantry, teen center, eagle house, council on aging) to document program needs and transition options if building were closed/demolished.

decisions.decision: Committee to participate in mandatory building tour of TC Passios; Select Board to schedule tours for week of August 10 or week after
decisions.quote: committee agreed a mandatory site tour of tcp for committee members was appropriate; select board to schedule building tours the week of aug 10 (or week after)

decisions.decision: Committee to plan public information sessions and outreach to present options and solicit community input on design and funding
decisions.quote: committee to plan public information sessions / outreach (not limited to town meeting) to present options and solicit community input

decisions.decision: Committee to meet again on Monday, August 3, in-person with Zoom option to discuss municipal space needs and preliminary cost estimates
decisions.quote: committee set next meeting date options: members discussed meeting availability; consensus reached to schedule the committee's next meeting (in-person with zoom option) for monday, august 3

decisions.decision: Committee reaffirmed that its charge allows analysis of TC Passios and other town-owned buildings, including municipal workspace, school uses, and community uses
decisions.quote: committee reaffirmed that its charge allows analysis of tc passios and other town-owned buildings and that municipal workspace, school uses, and community uses are within the committee's remit.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Potential incentive caps available for new construction and major renovations under state Mass Save program
budget_items.quote: potential incentives up to ~$2.75-$3.00/sq ft tiers and verification support (caps typically referenced at ~$3m).

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Estimated cost to replace roof portions and stop ongoing water intrusion at TC Passios
budget_items.quote: estimate to replace portions to stop ongoing water intrusion ~ $1.1m-$1.4m

budget_items.topic: Asbestos abatement and lead paint remediation costs
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Estimated cost for asbestos abatement and lead paint remediation required for any renovation at TC Passios
budget_items.quote: asbestos abatement and lead paint remediation required for any renovation - estimated in the high hundreds of thousands to ~$800k-$1m

budget_items.topic: FY23 capital appropriation for roof repairs
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Prior capital appropriation from FY23 was double-counted and adjusted; no current unrestricted funds reserved for roof replacement
budget_items.quote: ($300k appropriation from fy23 capital plan was double-counted/adjusted; no currently available appropriation for full roof replacement).

budget_items.topic: Comparison demolition cost from prior project
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Reference cost from previous municipal building demolition in 2023, used to estimate potential TC Passios demolition costs
budget_items.quote: previous demolition of smaller building in 2023 cost $775k; tcp demolition expected to be substantially more

budget_items.topic: Boiler system repair and replacement costs
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Immediate boiler repair costs estimated in low thousands; larger systemic replacement costs needed for long-term reliability
budget_items.quote: costs cited in low thousands for immediate repair but larger systemic costs to make reliable

topics.topic: Mass Energy and Mass Save Programs Presentation
topics.resolution: Presented and discussed; committee encouraged to engage utilities early and pursue building assessments
topics.quote: presentation: mass energy / mass save programs (presenter: dave) • overview: summary of mass save / state program incentives and technical assistance for new construction and major renovations

topics.topic: TC Passios Building Condition Assessment and Future Options
topics.resolution: Multiple scenarios discussed; cost estimates and feasibility analysis directed for FY28 capital planning; stakeholder engagement and site tours planned
topics.quote: focused discussion of tc passios condition, uses, and next steps under the committee charge. brooks house and municipal space program needs were discussed as related items.
